title: 第一卷 第3章 抓药
novel_title: 津门武圣，从苦力开始每日结算
content_zh:
雨又下了。

    津门的雨，总是带着一股子洗不净的煤渣味。

    陆川背着陆小鱼，深一脚浅一脚地踩在烂泥里。

    “哥......放我下来......”

    背上的声音细若游丝，像只快断气的小猫。

    “闭嘴。”

    陆川脚步没停，反而更快了几分。

    他感觉到了。

    背上那具瘦小的躯体，正在变得滚烫。

    那是肺痨入骨的症状。

    ......

    半小时前。

    猪笼巷，漏风的窝棚。

    陆川将一个塞满肉片的馒头和一碗热汤递了过去。

    “哥，我不饿......”

    陆小鱼缩在稻草堆里，脸色惨白，只有颧骨处泛着两团诡异的潮红。

    “不饿也得吃。”

    陆川皱着眉头，语气不容置疑。

    陆小鱼勉强撑起身子，刚接过碗，喉咙里突然发出一阵拉风箱似的喘息声。

    “咳！咳咳咳......”

    她捂着嘴，瘦弱的肩膀剧烈颤抖。

    陆川眉头一皱，伸手去拉她的手腕。

    入手一阵滚烫。

    “咳……噗！”

    一口黑血，顺着陆小鱼的指缝喷了出来，溅在那碗浑面汤里。

    血沫子翻滚，触目惊心。

    陆小鱼两眼一翻，身子软软地倒了下去。

    “小鱼！”

    陆川一把捞住她。

    那一瞬间，他脑子里那根名为“理智”的弦，崩断了。

    ......

    法租界，圣心医院。

    这是津门最好的洋人医院，红砖白墙，尖顶钟楼，门口站着两个持枪的印度巡捕。

    “站住！”

    印度巡捕手里的警棍一横，拦住了一身泥水的陆川。

    “支那人，这里不是你们该来的地方。”

    巡捕操着生硬的汉语，眼神像看垃圾一样。

    陆川没停步，直接从怀里掏出一块银元，塞进巡捕手里。

    “我妹病了，看急症。”

    银元入手冰凉。

    巡捕掂了掂，脸上那股子傲慢劲儿稍微收敛了点，但警棍还是没挪开。

    “挂号费两块，看病五块，药费另算。”

    巡捕咧开大嘴，露出一口黄牙，“没钱就滚。”

    陆川没废话，又摸出两块大洋拍在他手里。

    “让开。”

    巡捕笑了，侧身放行。

    在津门，只要给钱，洋人的医院也不是进不得。

    ......

    急诊室。

    一股子刺鼻的来药水味。

    一个穿着白大褂的洋大夫正坐在办公桌后写病历，鼻梁上架着金丝眼镜。

    陆川冲进去，一把陆小鱼放在诊疗床上。

    “大夫，救人。”

    洋大夫抬头，瞥了一眼满身泥水、散发着汗臭味的陆川，眉头瞬间皱成了川字。

    他捏着鼻子，挥了挥手，像是在赶苍蝇。

    “出去出去！这里不接待乞丐！”

    陆川站在原地没动，声音沙哑：“我有钱。”

    “钱？”

    洋大夫嗤笑一声，指了指墙上的牌子，“看到没有？本院只接待体面人。”

    “你这一身脏东西，会弄脏我的地板。”

    “我妹快死了！”

    陆川的手按在诊疗床上，指节发白。

    “那是她的事。”

    洋大夫不耐烦地合上病历本，“保安！把这个支那乞丐扔出去！”

    门外两个华人保安立刻冲了进来，手里拎着警棍。

    “滚！”

    保安一棍子抽在陆川背上。

    陆川没动。

    那根实木警棍抽在他背上，像是抽在牛皮鼓上，发出“砰”的一声闷响。

    保安愣住了，这苦力身上是铁打的？

    陆川缓缓转过头。

    那双眼睛里没有怒火，只有一片死寂的冰冷。

    就像是在看一具尸体。

    保安被看得心里发毛，下意识退了半步。

    “哥......”

    床上的陆小鱼微弱地喊了一声，嘴角又溢出一丝黑血

    陆川收回目光。

    他没再理会那个洋大夫和保安。

    弯腰，抱起陆小鱼。

    转身，出门。

    “算你识相！”

    洋大夫在后面骂骂咧咧，“也不撒泡尿照照自己，配用西药吗？”

    陆川脚步顿了顿。

    他没回头。

    只是把那个洋大夫的样子，记在了心里。

    这世道，拳头没硬之前，忍字头上一把刀。
content_en:
It rained again.

    The rain in Jinmen always carries the smell of cinders that cannot be washed away.

    Lu Chuan carried Lu Xiaoyu on his back and stepped deeply into the mud.

    "Brother... put me down..."

    The voice on his back was as thin as a gossamer, like a kitten that was about to expire.

    "Shut up."

    Lu Chuan didn't stop, but moved a little faster.

    He felt it.

    The thin body on his back was getting hot.

    That is the symptom of tuberculosis that penetrates the bones.

    ...

    half an hour ago.

    Pig cage alley, a drafty shack.

    Lu Chuan handed over a steamed bun stuffed with sliced ​​meat and a bowl of hot soup.

    "Brother, I'm not hungry..."

    Lu Xiaoyu huddled in the straw, his face pale, with only two groups of strange flushes on his cheekbones.

    "You have to eat even if you're not hungry."

    Lu Chuan frowned, his tone unquestionable.

    Lu Xiaoyu barely pushed himself up, and just as he took the bowl, a gasping sound suddenly came from his throat like a bellows.

    "Cough! Cough cough cough..."

    She covered her mouth, her thin shoulders shaking violently.

    Lu Chuan frowned and reached out to pull her wrist.

    It was piping hot in my hand.

    "Ahem...poof!"

    A mouthful of black blood spurted out from between Lu Xiaoyu's fingers and splashed into the bowl of muddy noodle soup.

    The blood foam rolled and was shocking.

    Lu Xiaoyu rolled his eyes and fell down softly.

    "Little fish!"

    Lu Chuan grabbed her.

    At that moment, the string called "reason" in his mind broke.

    ...

    French Concession, Sacred Heart Hospital.

    This is the best hospital for foreigners in Tianjin, with red bricks and white walls, a steeple bell tower, and two Indian policemen with guns standing at the door.

    "Stop!"

    The Indian patrolman swung his baton and stopped Lu Chuan, who was covered in mud and water.

    "Chinese people, this is not the place you should come."

    The patrolman spoke stilted Chinese and looked at him like he was looking at garbage.

    Lu Chuan didn't stop, he took out a silver dollar from his pocket and put it into the patrolman's hand.

    "My sister is sick and needs emergency treatment."

    The silver dollar is cold.

    The patrolman weighed it, and the arrogance on his face softened a little, but he still didn't move his baton.

    "The registration fee is two yuan, the doctor's fee is five yuan, and the medicine fee is extra."

    The patrolman grinned widely, showing his yellow teeth, "If you don't have any money, get out."

    Lu Chuan didn't talk nonsense and took out two more pieces of ocean and patted them in his hand.

    "Get out of the way."

    The patrolman smiled and turned aside to let him go.

    In Jinmen, as long as you pay, foreigners can't get into hospitals.

    ......

    emergency room.

    There was a pungent smell of medicine.

    A foreign doctor in a white coat was sitting behind his desk writing medical records, with gold-rimmed glasses on his nose.

    Lu Chuan rushed in and placed Lu Xiaoyu on the treatment bed.

    "Doctor, help me."

    Doctor Yang raised his head and glanced at Lu Chuan, who was covered in mud and smelled of sweat. His brows instantly furrowed into the character "Sichuan".

    He pinched his nose and waved his hand as if to shoo away flies.

    "Get out, get out! We don't accept beggars here!"

    Lu Chuan stood still and said in a hoarse voice, "I have money."

    "Money?"

    The foreign doctor sneered and pointed at the sign on the wall, "Did you see it? This hospital only accepts decent people."

    "Your dirty clothes will stain my floor."

    "My sister is dying!"

    Lu Chuan pressed his hand on the diagnosis and treatment bed, his knuckles turning white.

    "That's her business."

    The foreign doctor impatiently closed the medical record book and said, "Security! Throw this Chinese beggar out!"

    Two Chinese security guards outside the door rushed in immediately, carrying batons in their hands.

    "Get out!"

    The security guard slapped Lu Chuan on the back.

    Lu Chuan didn't move.

    The solid wood baton hit his back like a cowhide drum, making a muffled sound.

    The security guard was stunned. Is this coolie made of iron?

    Lu Chuan slowly turned his head.

    There was no anger in those eyes, only a dead coldness.

    It was like looking at a corpse.

    The security guard was so frightened that he subconsciously took a step back.

    "Brother..."

    Lu Xiaoyu shouted weakly on the bed, and a trace of black blood spilled from the corner of his mouth.

    Lu Chuan withdrew his gaze.

    He ignored the foreign doctor and security guard.

    Bend down and pick up Lu Xiaoyu.

    Turn around and go out.

    "You know what's going on!"

    The foreign doctor was cursing from behind, "I don't want to urinate and take care of myself. Is it appropriate to take western medicine?"

    Lu Chuan paused.

    He didn't look back.

    I just kept the appearance of that foreign doctor in my heart.

    In this world, before your fist is hardened, you can bear a knife on your head.
